crop.board: three equal square panels; fixed camera

candidates.name: 大きな樹冠の庭
candidates.direction: Direction A: eight trees planted as a compact irregular cluster behind and left of the cottage, with a generous front clearing. LEFT: eight low little separate rounded saplings. MIDDLE: boughs begin linking and three leaf masses overlap while all trunks stay grounded. RIGHT: those same eight trunks collectively support one broad majestic, layered mushroom-shaped canopy made of many organic boughs and lobed crowns, not a single new magic trunk. The trunks make a little accessible forest room with a light opening at front; branches are curved, gentle and physically credible. Canopy is about three cottage heights and substantially broader than the house. Green and pale yellow-green outer leaf masses, brighter small illuminated openings below. A tiny resident resting in visible shade emphasizes that a living place grew from the planted cluster. No fabricated treehouse or decoration.
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a beautiful, credible real-time 3D game art direction board for Sansu. A wide horizontal triptych with THREE equal square scene panels, narrow plain white gutters, no text or UI anywhere. These are the same island photographed with exactly the SAME orthographic 3/4 isometric camera at three times: left newly planted, middle connecting, right fully grown. Each square corresponds to the actual 390x388 mobile island art viewport, above controls. Keep ALL of each island, canopy and its footing visible within each square; use a fixed camera scale generous enough for the final grown silhouette. No zooming between panels.
Reference roles: image1 existing initial Sansu screenshot = bright clear blue sea, rounded soft game geometry, charming toy-scale home, clear readable spatial composition. Ignore its UI. Image2 existing crowded mature screenshot = diagnostic of what MUST CHANGE (scattered tiny unrelated props, flat rectangle, huge unearned background branch), but preserve familiar home/resident design vocabulary. Image3 actual original Pokomoko portrait = exact character identity; cream left face, blue right face, tiny black bead eyes, cream muzzle, asymmetrical black dotted and pink dotted round ears, multicolored patchwork body, red scarf. Do NOT redesign into a generic big-eyed mascot. Depict one tiny resident at appropriate home-relative scale, all body grounded, recognizable patchwork color masses.
Shared scene invariants: same softly rounded small island footprint, surrounding clean blue water with delicate wave glints and shallow shore, pale fresh grassy ground with sandy rim and light exposed soil, no floating island or platform suspended in sky. SAME one small existing cottage near front-right, soft beige walls and colorful patchwork roof, blue door; SAME one resident near the cottage. SAME eight planted trees in precisely the same ground positions throughout the three states. Planted trunks remain distinguishable in the grown state: interlocking growth never consumes owned trees or changes their positions. Trees start as little rounded fresh green saplings and become mature with visible trunk thickening and connecting boughs. No sudden teleportation or creation of new props, houses, artificial furniture, waterfalls or giant free backdrop. Early state already charming with well-composed empty ground; later state becomes a substantially larger inhabited PLACE, not eight bigger standalone trees.
Art finish: beautiful polished rounded stylized 3D, softly chamfered sculptural volumes with deliberate unevenness, matte painted wood, velvety grouped leaf masses, varied but restrained material response, contact shadows grounding everything and soft bright daylight. Distinct fore/mid/back layers; cyan sea and sunny light neutral ground keep the frame airy, plant greens occupy limited coherent masses. Tiny coral/yellow/blue home and character accents. Fairy-tale wonder comes from mature organic ARCHITECTURE, scale contrast, enveloping space and actual places to inhabit, visible in daytime. No dark teal grade, no all-green washed screen, no dense clutter, no ubiquitous sparkles, crystals, neon glow, lamp strings, ornaments, candy props or generic magical symbols.
A single wordless action-and-payoff story: plant these trees near one another -> their boughs reach across -> their crowns meet -> the small resident has a larger shaded place to walk, rest or gather beneath. The right mature panel must be the visual magnet: want to walk into this environment. Respect walkable negative space and don't hide the cottage, resident or ground connection. Keep the same house shape, roof patches, sea tone, light direction and island perimeter identical between panels. Do not add labels, borders, arrows, legends, title, app chrome or buttons.

MIDDLE: boughs begin linking and three leaf masses overlap while all trunks stay grounded. RIGHT: those same eight trunks collectively support one broad majestic, layered mushroom-shaped canopy made of many organic boughs and lobed crowns, not a single new magic trunk. The trunks make a little accessible forest room with a light opening at front; branches are curved, gentle and physically credible. Canopy is about three cottage heights and substantially broader than the house. Green and pale yellow-green outer leaf masses, brighter small illuminated openings below. A tiny resident resting in visible shade emphasizes that a living place grew from the planted cluster. No fabricated treehouse or decoration.

candidates.name: 枝がつながる森の道
candidates.direction: Direction B: eight trees arranged as two loose staggered rows of four, framing a wide curved path from front-left shoreline toward the cottage behind-right. LEFT: separate low rounded saplings show this layout already. MIDDLE: neighboring trunks bend naturally inward and their boughs begin linking over the passage. RIGHT: their thick gracefully curved boughs form an asymmetrical sequence of three broad organic tree arches, a continuous airy woodland arcade with linked rounded leaf crowns. Keep ground pathway naturally open and visible, with no new paving/construction props. The route's end and cottage remain visible through the arches and to their right. The resident walks along the passage. Strong diagonal depth, fantasy in the living organic architecture rather than particles, distinct multiple trunks remain visible. Arcade roughly three cottage heights at highest point; no dark tunnel, no rigid identical repeated arches.

candidates.name: 木々が囲むひらけた広場
candidates.direction: Direction C: the SAME eight trees arranged in an open irregular horseshoe/crescent around an empty central gathering clearing, house on front-right edge. LEFT: little separate saplings outline the open crescent, no thick forest. MIDDLE: tree crowns start touching along the sides and the back, center stays open to sky. RIGHT: mature trees form a sweeping sculptural living amphitheatre: broad joined rounded crowns and gently curving boughs trace the crescent, higher at the rear and lower toward the inviting open front. Large clear sunlit center with exposed grassy ground and soft patterned canopy shade around edges. A few restrained ivory blossoms appear as part of these trees, no extra standalone flower props. The resident stands on the clearing's edge, a place for multiple residents to gather later. A beautiful broad grown silhouette, around three cottage heights at the back, with clean view into the living court. Do not turn into a perfect symmetrical circle, garden gazebo, stone ruin, temple or center fountain. The connected grove itself is the architecture.
